logic.summary: Long-only M15 SMA(28)/SMA(101) Close crossover; cross-down exits; 1000-point spread guard on entry.
logic.economic_rationale: Slow SMA crossover on M15 captures sustained intraday-to-multiday gold trend shifts while filtering minute noise.
known_assumptions: Uses closed bars only (CopyBuffer shift 1 and 2) so there is no intrabar lookahead.
Long-only: cross-down closes but never reverses to short.
rejection_criteria: Net Out-of-Sample expectancy <= 0 after realistic M15 spread/slippage.
Edge disappears when SMA periods are perturbed by +/-20%.
